director is of the opinion that the adult is endangered or neglected 
and in need of care, the director must take whatever action that the 
director considers appropriate, in cluding the provision of services 
and supports, to ensure the safety and personal dignity of the adult. 
The question being put, the amendment was defeated.  With Mr. Rogers at the Table,
